name: City of Luxembourg: its Old Quarters and Fortifications
description: The old centre of Luxembourg City sits on a rocky spur above deep river gorges, a position that made it one of Europe's mightiest fortresses until its walls were pulled down in 1867. Today you can walk the Chemin de la Corniche, explore the tunnels of the Bock casemates, and see the Grand Ducal Palace and Notre-Dame Cathedral. The fortress changed hands between Burgundians, Habsburgs, French, Spanish and Prussians.
